prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers stated no police report was filed at the scene. Initial photos of the vehicles requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant's vehicle inspected. Damage limited to the rear quarter panel and passenger door. Repair estimate received from preferred shop and under review. Claimant reports a back strain and has been advised to seek medical evaluation.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and filed in the claim file. Medical records and bills requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Liability analysis in progress. Insured's statement and the claimant's statement differ on whether a turn signal was used. Independent witness not yet located. Reviewing available traffic camera footage from the area.

Entry 5: Demand package received from claimant's attorney including treatment notes for lumbar strain and a request for settlement review. File referred to supervisor for evaluation. Reserve review scheduled.
